result.summary: Adds `--no-same-owner` to `TAR_OPTIONS` in the Guix codesigning script (`codesign.sh`). This prevents `tar` from attempting to restore original file ownership when extracting codesigning archives.
result.problem: Running `guix-codesign` as root inside container environments fails with `Cannot change ownership to uid 0, gid 0: Invalid argument` when unpacking codesigning tarballs, blocking signers using container images.
evidence: PR description documents extraction failures on v32.0: `tar: ./detached-sig-create.sh: Cannot change ownership to uid 0, gid 0: Invalid argument ... tar: Exiting with failure status due to previous errors`
PR description notes that PR #34550 previously applied `--no-same-owner` to `build.sh` (now `setup.sh`) but omitted `codesign.sh`
result.changed_since_previous: None; the diff and commit remain identical.
result.card: Adds `--no-same-owner` to `TAR_OPTIONS` in the Guix codesigning script. Running `guix-codesign` as root inside container environments causes `tar` to abort with ownership errors when unpacking codesigning archives. This mirrors a prior fix applied to Guix setup in PR #34550, enabling release signers to extract tarballs properly inside containers.

risk.why: A bug would only affect release codesigning script execution during release preparation.
